architecture.mechanism: Real-time monitoring of power battery temperature to ensure normal power supply
architecture.intervention: Integrate a real-time temperature monitoring module into the R525 vehicle battery thermal management system that triggers active cooling or power derating before thermal runaway thresholds are reached, preventing sudden propulsion loss.
architecture.expected_effect: Prevention of battery thermal runaway during high ambient temperatures, thereby maintaining continuous power supply to propulsion and braking systems.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the modified R525 battery system to sustained high ambient temperature cycling while simulating high discharge rates; failure occurs if battery temperature exceeds safe limits or if power supply is interrupted before the defined thermal runaway point.
